attributes.facts: "{'found': True, 'event': 'kb_answers', 'answers': [{'question': 'How do I know if the device is working correctly?', 'short_answer': 'Use “See My Heart” in the app (or ask me) to view a live trace. If you can’t see the trace or the app shows no connection, contact patient care.'}, {'question': 'What should I do if no heartbeat trace is showing in the app?', 'short_answer': 'Check that stickers and leads are firmly attached and replace any loose sticker. Then use “See My Heart.” If there’s still no trace, contact patient care.'}, {'question': 'What if the device is not updating?', 'short_answer': 'Updates happen automatically and there’s no manual update option. Use “See My Heart” to confirm the live signal is working.'}, {'question': 'Do I need to keep the app open?', 'short_answer': 'Keep the HeartBug app running in the background and don’t force-quit it, so recordings can sync and upload properly.'}, {'question': 'What if my phone loses connection during monitoring?', 'short_answer': 'The device keeps monitoring and stores data if your phone disconnects. When it reconnects, your data uploads automatically.'}], 'score': 0.899}"
attributes.tts: "The most likely reason is that the live trace isn’t getting through yet, so please check that the stickers and leads are firmly attached, then open “See My Heart” again; if it still shows no trace or no connection, contact patient care."
